data.gender_notes: Akhilesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Akhi means 'eye' and Ilesh means 'unconquerable'. The name Akhilesh is derived from the Hindu god Indra, who is believed to have the power to see the past, present and future. The name symbolizes the power of vision and the ability to overcome obstacles. The name Akhilesh carries the meaning “Invincible, unconquerable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Akhilesh usually hope their child will grow to embody invincible, unconquerable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek inner strength and wisdom to overcome challenges in life.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akhilesh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Akhilesh is a traditional Hindu name, often found among communities in India and Nepal. Its meaning, 'unconquerable eye', suggests a strength and resilience in the face of adversity, which is highly valued in Hindu culture. This name is often given to sons, and is believed to bring good luck, prosperity and a sharp intelligence to the child who bears it.

historical_references.reference: Akhilesh was a renowned king of the Haihayas dynasty, ruling from around 1175 to 1130 BCE in the eastern part of the Indian subcontinent. He is best known for his military prowess, which earned him the title 'Akhilesh' which means 'incomparable to Arjuna in battle' in the Mahabharata epic.
historical_references.context: Haihayas Dynasty, eastern part of the Indian subcontinent

historical_references.reference: Akhilesh was a Jat ruler of the Mewat region in Rajasthan, India, during the late 16th and early 17th centuries. He was a strong opponent of the Mughal Empire and led several rebellions against Mughal rule. Akhilesh is also known for his patronage of art and architecture, particularly the construction of the Dargah of Kheshwa Mahal and the fort of Amer.
historical_references.context: Jat ruler, Mewat region, Rajasthan, India, opposition to Mughal Empire
